stem: A printed SOP at a workstation has no visible revision number. What should the technician do before relying on it?
choices: Verify it against the controlled document source or supervisor process before use
Assume the printed copy is current
Write today's date on it and continue
Use whichever copy has the most handwritten notes
rationale: An uncontrolled or unidentified copy should be verified before use so the technician does not execute an obsolete procedure.
